# Dharmik Gohil

> Full Stack Software Engineer & System Architect based in Surat, Gujarat, India, specializing in ERPNext & Frappe customization, custom CRM platform engineering, scalable web applications, microservices architecture, and cloud infrastructure.

Dharmik Gohil builds production software using React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, Python, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, and AWS/Docker/Kubernetes-based cloud infrastructure. Core focus areas: ERPNext/Frappe custom DocTypes and workflow automation, multi-tenant CRM platforms, REST/GraphQL API design, and database performance tuning.
